name: Ashbound Initiate
entriesHtml:
You have learned a certain number of the secrets and techniques of the Ashbound druidic order. You gain the following benefits.

Ashbound Proficiencies.

You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

Arcane Enmity.

When a creature you can see casts a spell, you have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls against that creature until the end of your next turn.

Ashbound Spells.

The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Ashbound Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

Spell LevelSpells
1stGuiding Bolt
2ndShining Smite
3rdNondetection
4thAura of Purity
5thCircle of Power

name: Gatekeeper Initiate
entriesHtml:

Protection Against Aberrations.

name: Greensinger Initiate
entriesHtml:
You have learned a certain number of secrets and techniques of the Greensinger druidic order. You gain the following benefits:

Greensinger's Proficiency.

You gain proficiency in the Performance skill.

Fey Dancer.

Whenever you cause a creature to gain the Charmed condition, you can join them in dance and revelry. If you do so, you can use your Reaction|XPHB to move up to half your Speed|XPHB without provoking Opportunity Attack.

Fey Affinity.

Your spells and magical abilities that affect Humanoids also affect Fey.

Greensinger Spells.

The secrets you've learned allow you to always have certain spells at the ready. When you have spell slots of a level specified in the Greensinger Spells table, you thereafter have the spells listed for that level and lower prepared.

name: Hewn for Battle
entriesHtml:
You have reshaped your stone body to be a more effective and devastating weapon of war. You gain the following benefits.

Thickened Hide.

When you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB, you can choose the thickness of your natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class|XPHB becomes your choice of either 14 plus your Dexterity modifier, or 18. You can use a Shield and still gain this benefit.

Spellcarving.

Your hide can be enchanted or infused as if it were nonmagical armor.

Claws.

You have shaped your hands into fearsome claws. Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes. If you hit with them, you deal Slashing damage equal to 1d6 plus your Strength modifier in place of the normal Bludgeoning damage of your Unarmed Strike|XPHB.

name: Orb Expert
entriesHtml:
Your skill with magical Orb helps you evade enemies while overcoming their defenses. You gain the following benefits.

Fortune Teller.

When you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB, roll 1d6 and record the result. When you cast a spell using an Orb as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you can add the result of this prescience roll to your spell attack roll, or reduce one target's saving throw by that amount. You must choose to do so before the attack roll or saving throw.

Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB. Unused prescience rolls are lost when you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

See the Path.

While you are holding an Orb, Opportunity Attack against you have Disadvantage|XPHB.

Prescient Escape.

While you are holding an Orb, whenever a creature you can see enters a space within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction|XPHB to move up to your Speed|XPHB without provoking an Opportunity Attack.

name: Rod Expert
entriesHtml:
You've mastered the use of a Rod as an Arcane Focus. You gain the following benefits.

Close-Ranged Focus.

If the target of a cantrip you cast using a Rod as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB is within 20 feet of you when you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

Unshakeable Casting.

When you make a ranged spell attack roll while using a Rod as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you do not have Disadvantage|XPHB on the roll if you are within 5 feet of an enemy.

Rough & Tumble.

When you make a ranged spell attack while using a Rod as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you can use a Bonus Action|XPHB to make a melee attack with your Rod. It counts as a Club for the purposes of the attack.

name: Shadow's Gift of Stone
entriesHtml:
You have learned to channel arcane power through your gaze. You gain the following benefits.

Innate Magic.

When you reach a character level specified in the Shadow's Gift of Stone Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared. You can cast each of these spells once without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest|XPHB before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Your spellcasting ability for these spells is the same as the spellcasting ability you chose for your Petrifying Gaze trait.

Character LevelSpell
4Ensnaring Strike
5Hold Person
9Hypnotic Pattern
13Stoneskin
17Hold Monster

name: Staff Expert
entriesHtml:
You've unlocked the deadly ranged potential of the Staff. You gain the following benefits.

Arcane Artillery.

When you cast a spell that has a range of 5 feet or greater using a Staff as your Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you can use a Bonus Action|XPHB to double the range of the spell.

Powerful Focus.

When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a cantrip you cast using a Staff as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

Explosive Casting.

If all targets of a spell you cast using a Staff as your Spellcasting Focus|XPHB are more than half the spell's range from you, one creature of your choice that you hit with a spell attack or that fails a saving throw against the spell has the Prone condition.

name: Stone Eyes
entriesHtml:
Your Petrifying Gaze has come into its own. You gain the following benefits.

Powerful Petrification.

If a creature that has the Restrained or Paralyzed condition as a result of one of your spells or your Medusa's Gift trait fails a saving throw to end the effect by 5 or more, you can choose to turn that creature to stone. Any magical effects causing the creature to have the Restrained or Paralyzed condition end, and the creature has the Petrified condition for 1 minute. You must concentrate to maintain the effect. If you lose your Concentration|XPHB, the Petrified condition ends. If you maintain your Concentration|XPHB on the effect for the entire possible duration, the target is Petrified until the condition is ended by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

name: Wand Expert
entriesHtml:

Wand Mastery.

If you make a spell attack using a Wand as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you gain Advantage|XPHB on the attack roll if the target hasn't taken a turn.

Arcane Quickdraw.

Drawing or stowing a Wand does not count against the number of object interactions you can take for free on your turn.
